title: pezzotto.ai launcher application manifest
description: One open-source application in the pezzotto.ai launcher catalog. One file per app: apps/<id>.json.

id.description: Reverse-DNS identifier. Reuse the AppStream / Flathub id when the app has one. Must match the file name.

description.description: Plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs.

license.description: SPDX license expression, e.g. GPL-3.0-or-later or MIT OR Apache-2.0. Must be an OSI/FSF-approved license.

icon.description: Square PNG or SVG, ideally at least 128px.

topics.description: Ids from topics.json. The first one is the primary topic.

certified.description: Set by scripts/pin.py once every download installer is pinned to one release (url + sha256). The launcher shows it and, in strict mode, only installs pinned downloads.

level.description: pinned: exact release files, with their hashes, in the signed catalog.

date.description: When the pins were last refreshed.

pezzotto.description: Present when the app is a knock-off of a closed-source original listed on pezzotto.ai. Written by scripts/pezzotto_sync.py from the site's catalog/clones.json; do not edit by hand.

entry.description: Id of the entry in the pezzotto.ai clone catalog. Its page is https://pezzotto.ai/#clone-<entry>.

of.description: The closed-source original this app imitates.

grade.description: pezzotto grade: from how far away does it still fool you? A: arm's length, B: three metres, C: across the street, D: you'd have to be told.

verified.description: run: someone from the stall ran the clone; desk: graded from docs, screenshots and the project's own parity claims.

status.description: alive: commits in the last 90 days; stale: 90 days to a year; abandoned: longer.

checked.description: When the stall last looked at the clone.

coverage.description: Features of the original the clone has.

missing.description: Features of the original the clone lacks.

installers.description: Ways to install the app, in order of preference. The launcher picks the first one that matches the current platform/arch and whose tool is available.

run.description: Command used to launch the installed app (argv). {dir} expands to the install directory for 'download' installers.

cask.description: true for a cask (GUI app), false for a formula. Defaults to true.

format.description: appimage: single executable file. archive: .zip or .tar.gz extracted into the app directory. binary: single executable. installer: native installer (.msi, .exe, .dmg, .pkg, .deb) handed to the OS.

url.description: Pinned download URL of one exact release file. May coexist with github: the pinned file is what gets installed, github is where scripts/pin.py looks for newer releases.

version.description: Version of the pinned file (release tag).

github.description: GitHub repository and release asset. Without url, the latest release is resolved at install time.

asset.description: Regular expression matched against release asset names.

exec.description: archive only: path of the executable inside the extracted directory.

strip_root.description: archive only: drop a single top-level directory. Defaults to true.
